cases.instruction: Make the truck a deep cherry red and give the sky a warm late-afternoon glow.
Bring out the city lights and cool the shadows a little.
Make the nearer cup matte black and the room a touch warmer.
Make the red gate stand out more and calm the busy colours around it.
Change her red sweater to a forest green knit.
Make the snow a cleaner white without changing her skin.
Turn his black jacket into a tan suede jacket.
Make the sky more dramatic and the water a deeper turquoise.
Replace the blue sofa with a green velvet one.
Make it feel like golden hour.
Remove the no-cycling sign from the pole.
Make the graffiti wall black and white and keep him in colour.
Brighten his face a little and make the crowd behind him less distracting.
